newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia CARTE insurance first half net.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia CARTE insurance first half net.

text.p: Tunisia's Compagnie d'Assurances et de Reassurances Tuniso-Europeenne CARTE net profits during the
first half of 1996 amounted to 1.39 million dinars, results published on Thursday showed.
Figures for the same period last year were not available for comparison, but the company reported a 2.52 million dinars net profit for 1995, up by 44 percent compared to 1994.
CARTE's investment certificates were last traded at the Tunis Stock Exchange at 34 dinars.
The privately-owned company has a capital of 10 million dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
